input: Write a eulogy for my grandfather's memorial

gold.taskTitle: Write a Eulogy for Grandfather's Memorial
gold.taskDescription: Write a heartfelt and personalized eulogy to be delivered at the user's grandfather's memorial service.

questions.title: What was your grandfather's name and age?
questions.description: Knowing his full name and age helps personalize the eulogy with specific, respectful details.

questions.title: When and where is the memorial service?
questions.description: The date, time, and venue help set the tone and ensure the eulogy is ready in time.

questions.title: How long should the eulogy be when spoken aloud?
questions.description: Typical eulogies range from 3 to 10 minutes; knowing the target length shapes the depth of content.

questions.title: Who will be delivering the eulogy at the service?
questions.description: Whether it is the user, another family member, or a officiant affects the voice and perspective of the writing.

questions.title: What are two or three stories that best capture him?
questions.description: Specific anecdotes, memories, or defining moments make a eulogy vivid and emotionally resonant.

questions.title: What tone should the eulogy strike overall?
questions.description: Understanding whether the family wants it solemn, celebratory, humorous, or a blend guides the writing style.

questions.title: What did he do for work or dedicate his life to?
questions.description: His career, passions, hobbies, or life mission give context to his legacy and what he meant to others.
